Protocol: P0 bootstrap once at service start; P1 start_conn with owner=>self() explicit; P2 monitor + persist pending context BEFORE first blocking call; P3 connect bounded; P4 request bounded; P5 BODY bounded (request/7 returns {ok,S,H} only, body is a separate call - a third phase a connect+request-only design would leave unbounded); P6 exit(ConnPid,kill) + bounded DOWN + demonitor. Five non-obvious pinned-path facts for AGY: start_conn is supervisor:start_child so NOT linked (start_link would kill the owner on kill); owner MUST be explicit or DefaultOwner is the SUPERVISOR and caller death is never observed; children are restart_type temporary so a kill causes no restart storm, only a SUPERVISOR REPORT; hackney_tcp:connect/4 function_clauses on a BINARY host and requires a charlist; connect/request/body are gen_statem:call and EXIT on timeout rather than returning an error, so each must be wrapped or a deadline becomes a caller crash. This directly repairs root orphan finding (connection alive 150ms after return). Under this the BEAM sleeper fails on invocation-id association regardless of executable, store path or epoch. FIRST BOOTSTRAP is a DISTINCT state B1-B4: no registration AND zero in-flight rows AND a new registration written at epoch 1 in the same admission; no registration but in-flight rows present is HOLD, never FirstBootstrap - the falsifier worked because a default epoch 1 made no-prior-writer indistinguishable from prior-at-epoch-1. FOUR REAL ROLES, RestForOne order load-bearing: R1 lifecycle/writer-admission guardian, R2 authority/control owner (re-fence after every blocking stage and before every separate store or network effect, AUTO-01), R3 inbox acquisition (bounded generation-coherent cursor, AUTO-03), R4 outbox delivery (chunker upstream of any drain loop plus PendingOperation on every uncertain outcome, AUTO-04 and AUTO-02). ANTI-DUMMY: each child needs an independent failure injection and an observable recovery assertion; a child that cannot be killed in a test does not count toward four, and four dummies are worse than one honest child because they make a conformance count pass while restart semantics stay untested. AUTO-01, AUTO-02 and AUTO-04 NOT re-derived on current bytes; AGY repair claim unverified; all remain OPEN. historical_acceptance.positive: One authorised poller advances telegram_poll_offset exactly once per update and emits one envelope.
historical_acceptance.negative: A second concurrent poller is refused; a forged update_id below the watermark is not re-ingested (ledger ingest_single already returns the existing record).
historical_acceptance.recovery: Crash between fetch and offset advance re-fetches the same update and ingests idempotently, producing no duplicate delivery.

historical_acceptance.positive: A chunked message delivers in order with redaction applied.
historical_acceptance.negative: The denied OS serial never leaves; already law-covered at build_send_payload.
historical_acceptance.recovery: The Markdown-to-plaintext fallback must not double-send. THIS IS NOT CURRENTLY PROVEN and is the one acceptance gap in this family.

historical_acceptance.positive: Same update twice yields one inbox record and one delivery.
historical_acceptance.negative: Mixed-bot batch rejected; unidentified update cannot advance the offset.
historical_acceptance.recovery: recover_request resumes per state without duplicating a delivered result.

historical_acceptance.positive: Every inbound directive is classified before dispatch and the verdict is recorded.
historical_acceptance.negative: /zigvm is refused at ingress and never reaches handle_zigvm; a /tool argument outside the allowlist is refused.
historical_acceptance.recovery: A classification failure refuses rather than falls through to dispatch.

historical_acceptance.positive: Each of the 14 pages renders values that change when the backend changes; a valid initData yields 200.
historical_acceptance.negative: Absent or expired initData yields 401 and NO page body; unknown /mini-application yields 404 not a 200 dashboard; a POST without Bearer/proof is refused.
historical_acceptance.recovery: Backend unavailable renders an explicit degraded state, never a hardcoded AllClear.

historical_acceptance.positive: A critical OTel span produces exactly one notification to the configured chat.
historical_acceptance.negative: No token appears in any MoZ param, log or Zenoh payload; no synthetic command is dispatched at startup.
historical_acceptance.recovery: MoZ unavailable queues or drops with an explicit record, never silently.

historical_acceptance.positive: Non-command text yields a bounded model reply within the daily budget.
historical_acceptance.negative: Unauthorised sender refused before any model call; over-budget refused before network I/O.
historical_acceptance.recovery: Model failure leaves no partial memory write.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Implement authenticated Mini App data and actions with exact routes and truthful observed state
acceptance: Normalize pathname separately from query, exact /mini-app boundary, unknown routes404; no prefix aliases.
Public static shell exposes no operational data; POST data API validates fresh initData and configured allowlisted user/chat before any backend read.
Use bounded request body; preserve existing bearer/proof rules outside explicitly typed Mini App route.
Shared typed Gleam observed/unavailable/stale state for all14 pages; no hardcoded healthy defaults; encode untrusted values safely.
Actions carry canonical Sa-plan/effect-time proof and request id; stale/replayed/unauthorized actions cause zero effects.
Accessible18-checkpoint component, full Tailnet navigation, actual action outcomes and no fake all-clear.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Independently verify Mini App auth data actions and browser behavior
acceptance: Independent HMAC fixtures, missing/expired/forged/wrong-user rejection before reads/effects.
HTTP route404/query/method/body-size tests plus real mobile/desktop browser keyboard/action/screenshot checks.
SDK blocked/offline, backend absent/stale, runtime loaded versus shim fallback and concurrent-action negatives.
Candidate byte binding and staged authenticated backend state changes; production and Telegram SDK acceptance separately stated.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Connect every Telegram command family to one typed guarded dispatcher and actual adapters
acceptance: One canonical owning dispatcher per77 observed unique command literals; old entrypoints delegate through guard.
Resolve actual read/control semantics per arm; source effect reachability is not backend proof.
Typed argv/fixed adapters, no interpolated shell commands from Telegram; /zigvm mutation stays refused until separately authorized action exists.
Read operations use actual observed services/canonical queries; unloaded NIF shim and unavailable backend return explicit status.
Implement requested advertised action families with current Sa-plan authority, receipt and effect-time fencing; downgrading to unavailable contains risk but does not count as feature completion.
Conversation model calls pass identity and budgets before I/O; bounded memory and failure recovery.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Independently verify command ownership guard backends conversation and refusals
acceptance: Per-command positive/negative/recovery matrix and actual adapter evidence; no static-success pass.
Unauthorized, stale authority, shell metacharacters, duplicate requests, model budget exhaustion and unloaded FFI negative controls.
Model API failures and no token/private payload reflection; all adapters remain bounded supervised Gleam.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Implement bounded Telegram media ingestion and delivery from reviewed design
acceptance: Source-bound media design adopted before edits; use actual configured backend capabilities.
Guard before download/model/storage, allowlisted Telegram transport paths, strict type/size/count/deadline limits.
No credential propagation, attachment execution or prompt-derived tool authorization.
Durable input/result identity and explicit unsupported/outcome-uncertain responses; photo/document/audio/voice/video coverage as defined by design.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Independently verify all adopted Telegram media cases and hostile inputs
acceptance: Per-type positive, malformed, oversized, timeout, hostile filename/URL/MIME and duplicate tests with synthetic fixtures.
Actual bounded transport and downstream adapter observations; no real private media copied into artifacts.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Replace synthetic Telegram gateway startup and credential-carrying messages with supervised outbox
acceptance: Remove synthetic startup intent; startup emits only observed service state.
Bot credential stays in reviewed private transport configuration, never MoZ/Zenoh/task/log payload.
Critical events use bounded policy-selected outbox requests; explicit capacity/failure/backpressure semantics.
Preserve broken prototype as historical non-admitted evidence; no separate competing poller path.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Verify Telegram gateway startup secrecy event routing and recovery
acceptance: Observe zero synthetic commands, no marker credential in captured bus/log data, correct allowed recipient, bounded failure queue.
Repeated source events and restart recovery do not create blind duplicate sends.

adopted_feature_acceptance.title: Verify complete staged Telegram operation and release readiness against current candidate
acceptance: Actual private HTTP Telegram simulator plus OTP service and native DB, restart/process death/timeout recovery, single-poller leases and callback acknowledgments.
Per-feature As-is/To-be/status/risk/mitigation dashboard, current formal/source/runtime obligations and all failures preserved.
Controlled actual Telegram acceptance only with authorized recipient/message and available credentials; no unsupported external completion claim.
Independent release/state authority, parent admission checks, then stabilized Jujutsu main integration; no Git mutation or blanket branch merge.
